name: Multi-brand
summary: One shared system with three brands as themes. Components never change; brand primitives do.
description: Multi-brand is an Open DS scheme: a full set of answers to the Open DS grammar, with the reasons behind each, usage rules, voice and tone, and the tokens that follow. One shared system with three brands as themes. Components never change; brand primitives do.

ai.use_when: Companies with several brands or white-label products on one component library.
ai.avoid_when: A single product with one brand: the brand layer is cost with no user.

scenarios: A customer signs up for a plan on the Birch site, then manages it in the shared account area.
A product team launches a fourth brand by adding brand primitives, without touching components.

voice.summary: A plain shared voice. Each brand adds its own tone on top, never its own structure.
principles: Shared structure: object, state, next step.
Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.

tone.error: Shared across brands: plain and specific.
tone.success: Brand tone allowed: Aster calm, Birch friendly, Coral upbeat.
tone.confirm: Shared across brands: plain and specific.
tone.onboarding: Brand tone allowed in the first headline only.

examples.text: Your card was declined. Try another card or contact your bank.
